concerns.text: The validation of regime distinctness (SC‑009) relies on the same volatility proxy (squared returns or rolling‑std) that is used as an emission feature in the HMM. Testing that regimes differ in volatility using a metric that directly informed the regime assignment is circular; the HMM will by construction separate observations on that proxy. An independent validation (e.g., using a separate realized‑volatility measure or out‑of‑sample volatility) should be added to substantiate that the identified regimes correspond to genuinely distinct market conditions.
